entries.english:
Relations with Rothenburg ob der Tauber.

Contains: 1. Dispute between Zaisolph von Rosenberg and the imperial city of Rothenburg over the arrest of Valentin Seytz in Rosenberg territory by the Rothenburg schultheiß of Oberstetten, 1565; 2. information from the Haltenbergstetten chancery about Anna Würth of Niederstetten at the request of the imperial city of Rothenburg, 1689; 3. alleged outbreak of a cattle epidemic in Oberstetten, 1712; 4. dispute with the Rothenburg schultheiß of Oberstetten over the felling of a pear tree in the Niederstetten district by Michael Mangold of Oberstetten, 1719.

Duration: 1565, 1689, 1712–1719

Extent: 1 file
